authentication.payload: Exact raw UTF-8 bytes exported by the platform
authentication.signature: Detached 64-byte binary Ed25519 signature over the exact payload bytes
authentication.trustAnchor: Coordinator-supplied platform public key; never embedded in the payload

notes: Availability and compliance are derived only from signed events.
Payload strings claiming verification, freshness, or compliance are ignored.
The evidence SHA-256 and signing-key fingerprint are emitted by the verifier.
